questions: When a price goes up or down, do you want to change the price of an item already on the list, or will you remove it and add it again?
Do you sell some things in more than one size or unit (for example, one tin and a full carton) at different prices? If so, should each size have its own price on the list?
Should prices be in Ghana cedis with pesewas (for example, GH₵ 12.50)?
answers: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
Ghana cedis, sometimes with pesewas, like 12.50.
